prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence “Today increasing importance is being attached to cultivating college students’ team spirit.” You can make statements, give reasons, or cite examples to develop your essay. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
first: Today increasing importance is being attached to cultivating college students’ team spirit.
body: Today increasing importance is being attached to cultivating college students’ team spirit. In modern society, many major tasks, from scientific research to business projects, are too complex for any individual to complete alone. As a result, employers now value the ability to cooperate as highly as professional knowledge.

Team spirit benefits students in many ways. When working in a team, they learn to communicate clearly, listen to different views and make the most of each member’s strengths. They also learn to put the common goal above personal interests. Last year, I took part in a business plan competition with four classmates. At first we argued constantly, but once we divided the work according to what each of us did best, our efficiency improved greatly and we finally won second place. That experience taught me that a team can achieve far more than its members working separately.

To cultivate team spirit, colleges can assign more group projects and encourage students to join clubs and sports teams. Students themselves should be willing to share responsibilities, respect their teammates and handle disagreements calmly. Those who learn to cooperate in college will be well prepared to succeed in their future careers.

prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence “In an era of information explosion, it is vitally important to develop the ability to think critically and make rational choices.” You can make statements, give reasons, or cite examples to develop your essay. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
first: In an era of information explosion, it is vitally important to develop the ability to think critically and make rational choices.
body: In an era of information explosion, it is vitally important to develop the ability to think critically and make rational choices. Every day we are flooded with news, advertisements and opinions from countless sources, and not all of them are accurate or well-intentioned.

Critical thinking helps us separate fact from rumor. Instead of believing everything we read online, we can check where a piece of information comes from, look for evidence and compare different sources before drawing conclusions. Critical thinking also protects us from being misled by advertisements. For example, some products claim to be “scientifically proven” without offering any real evidence, and a critical thinker will question such claims rather than buy on impulse. Equally important is making rational choices. When choosing a major, for instance, a wise student weighs interests, abilities and job prospects instead of blindly following the crowd.

To develop this ability, students should get into the habit of asking questions such as “Who says so?” and “What is the evidence?” Schools can also offer courses on logic and media literacy. With a clear and critical mind, we will no longer be at the mercy of the information around us.

prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence “With the application of information technology in education, college students can now learn in more diverse and efficient ways.” You can make statements, give reasons, or cite examples to develop your essay. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
first: With the application of information technology in education, college students can now learn in more diverse and efficient ways.
body: With the application of information technology in education, college students can now learn in more diverse and efficient ways. Gone are the days when learning was limited to textbooks and classrooms. Today, a smartphone opens the door to a world of knowledge.

First, learning has become more diverse. Through online courses, students can attend lectures by famous professors from other universities, and through virtual labs, they can conduct experiments that would be too expensive or dangerous in real life. Second, learning has become more efficient. Smart study apps can analyze students’ performance and recommend exercises that target their weak points, so students no longer waste time on what they have already mastered. In addition, recorded lectures and online discussion platforms allow students to make full use of their spare time. Last semester, for instance, I prepared for a statistics exam with an online course, replaying the difficult parts until I fully understood them.

However, technology is only a tool. Without self-discipline, students can easily be distracted by games and social media. Therefore, they should use these resources purposefully and combine online learning with face-to-face communication. Properly used, information technology can transform the way we learn.

You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
first: Nowadays more and more people keep learning new skills to adapt to a fast-changing world.
body: Nowadays more and more people keep learning new skills to adapt to a fast-changing world. New technologies, new industries and new ways of working are emerging so quickly that skills people acquired a few years ago can soon become outdated.

There are several reasons for this trend. To begin with, learning new skills is essential for staying competitive in the job market. As many routine jobs are being taken over by machines, those who can operate new equipment or analyze data are more likely to find good jobs. Furthermore, new skills help people cope with changes in daily life. My parents, for example, learned to use mobile payment and video calls in their fifties, and now they can shop online and keep in touch with distant relatives easily. Finally, learning itself brings a sense of achievement and keeps the mind active, even in old age.

In my view, this is a positive trend. In a world where change is the only constant, the ability to keep learning is more valuable than any single skill. We should therefore develop the habit of lifelong learning so that we can face the future with confidence and curiosity.

You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
first: Nowadays more and more people choose to live an environmentally friendly lifestyle.
body: Nowadays more and more people choose to live an environmentally friendly lifestyle. They take public transportation, sort their garbage, carry reusable shopping bags and avoid wasting food. Such green habits, once considered unusual, have become part of many people’s daily routines.

Several factors have contributed to this change. First, people have become increasingly aware of environmental problems such as air pollution and climate change, and they realize that every individual’s choices make a difference. Second, the Chinese government has encouraged green living through policies such as mandatory waste sorting and the promotion of electric vehicles. Third, a green lifestyle often benefits people themselves. Cycling to work, for instance, not only reduces emissions but also keeps people fit, and saving water and electricity lowers household bills.

In my opinion, this trend deserves our full support. Although one person’s efforts may seem small, the combined efforts of millions can greatly improve our environment. Each of us can start with simple actions, such as turning off the lights when leaving a room and saying no to disposable chopsticks and plastic straws. If we all play our part, our planet will be a cleaner and healthier home for future generations.
